tools.name: site_overview
tools.description: How the site did over a period compared with the one before it: clicks, impressions, CTR, average position and the change in each. Covers the question 'how is my site doing'.

tools.name: top
tools.description: Top queries, pages, countries or devices for a period. Optionally narrowed to one country or device — 'top pages in Germany on mobile' is one call.

tools.name: changes
tools.description: What gained and what lost between this period and the one before it, with small rows filtered out. Answers 'what dropped in the last 28 days'.

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Queries ranking 5-20 with plenty of impressions but a click-through rate below what is typical at their position — where a title or snippet rewrite is worth the most clicks.

tools.name: find_cannibalization
tools.description: Queries where more than one page of the site is being shown, with how each page does on them.

tools.name: page_queries
tools.description: What searches a specific page is shown for.

tools.name: brand_split
tools.description: Branded versus non-branded search, split on the words supplied. The split is only as good as those terms: misspellings and the domain name catch more of what people type.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Direct query against Google's Search Analytics API, with the same dates, dimensions and filters it takes, passed through unchanged.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Search Console properties this connection can read, from Google's Sites API. These are the exact strings the site argument takes.

tools.name: inspect_url
tools.description: Google's index status for one URL, as the URL Inspection API reports it: whether it is indexed, when it was last crawled, and which canonical Google chose.

tools.name: list_sitemaps
tools.description: Sitemaps submitted for the property and their status, from Google's Sitemaps API. Read-only: submitting is not possible with read access.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "query" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "site_overview" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "How the site did over a period compared with the one before it: clicks, impressions, CTR, average position and the change in each. Start here for 'how is my site doing'." → after: "How the site did over a period compared with the one before it: clicks, impressions, CTR, average position and the change in each. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
